location.fixed_entry_description: Yellow triple upward arrow stand at pale building with dark blue window shutters on north side of short east-west road just before Hibernal Avenue. Tree with purple/pink Mega Crystal growth near opposite side of street.
location.directions: From Sushi High Roller continue EAST along the south side of Dormez Bien Cemetery. Before meeting Hibernal Avenue, locate the fixed gold Holovator directly against the building to your LEFT (the north-side frontage), and take it to the pale light-tiled rooftop.
location.rooftop_description: Wide pale beige flat deck with grasses and bushy hedges along edge and grey tiled pitched roofs to right. In the distance a blue mountain skyline. The roof image shows Investigate prompt on the arrival pad.

distinction_and_source_reconciliation.new_east_lift_location: Further east along the east-west road south of Dormez Bien Cemetery at Rouge Sector 6, near Hibernal Avenue
